pages.text: Summerpack mixes three big themes: $(bold)technology$() (Create, Modern Industrialization, Applied Energistics 2), $(bold)exploration$() (End Remastered's custom eyes, Stellaris space travel, new dungeons and structures from Yung's mods), and $(bold)adventure$() (new weapons, accessories, and dimensions).

There's no fixed progression path - pick a theme and go. Check the other sections of this book for a quick tour of what each part of the pack does, and check your $(bold)Book of Eyes$() for everything about the End Remastered eyes specifically.
